specs.title: Embeddable booking widget
specs.why: Merchants with an existing site convert better booking in place than being sent elsewhere.
specs.scope: Script tag and iframe widget the business embeds on its own site.
tasks: Add `public/widget.js`: implement the loader with height messaging
acceptance: The widget renders on a plain HTML page, verified by `pnpm test`
The accessibility pass in `tests/embed.test.ts` reports zero critical issues

specs.title: Observability
specs.why: Agent and payment failures are invisible without tracing, and invisible failures erode trust.
specs.scope: Structured logging, tracing across agent tool calls, dashboards and alerts with runbook links.
tasks: Add `lib/logger.ts`: implement the logger emitting request and tenant ids
Add `lib/agent/runtime.ts`: wrap tool calls with spans
acceptance: Every line from `lib/logger.ts` carries requestId and tenantId, verified by `pnpm test`
An agent tool call emits a span
A synthetic failure triggers an alert linking to `docs/runbooks/`
